_commentaire: Wrapper model: Intune does NOT deploy the vendor's DMG, it deploys our pkg
which contains it. This is the exact transposition of what PSADT does on the
Windows side, where Intune runs MacADT_installer.exe and not 7z2501-x64.exe.
The app therefore becomes a #microsoft.graph.macOSPkgApp, which unlocks the
preInstallScript / postInstallScript — inaccessible to the macOSDmgApp type
1. preInstallScript  -> macadt-deploy pre     : dialog, deferral, close
3. postInstallScript -> macadt-deploy post    : mounts, copies, hardens, detects
The DMG is never mounted on the build host: it travels as an opaque file in
the payload. Only the device needs hdiutil.
